parent_anchor.name: LightGCN++
parent_anchor.mechanism_summary: Learned propagation normalization plus learned residual/layer fusion on the LightGCN collaborative graph backbone.

search_objective: Grow one LightGCN++-rooted search tree and maximize real fixed-protocol data/dev NDCG@10. Explicitly choose the frozen LightGCN++ root or an existing resolvable descendant as construction parent, independently of the best measured result; keep LightGCN++ as the permanent paired comparator.

decision_semantics.root_parent: LightGCN++ is the permanent frozen root anchor and paired comparator for every candidate.
decision_semantics.active_lineage_parent: Choose the construction parent from the available frozen root and existing descendants; update the measured best independently.
decision_semantics.ordinary_search: Develop focused, faithful improvements from the selected construction parent. The causal thesis may coordinate multiple mechanisms when needed, without unrelated mechanism bundling.
decision_semantics.innovation_lane: frontier_architect explores more aggressive improvements from the selected LightGCN++-rooted parent and may cross zones or define new typed mechanisms when expected effect justifies it.
